title: RBS Portal — Reliable Internet Identity auth flow + Acquisition WhatsApp unlock redirection

requirements.summary: Make Internet Identity login/logout interactions resilient to double-clicks, stale state, and the 'already authenticated' loop without altering visual design or editing immutable auth hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Login successfully authenticates and enables authenticated-gated pages without requiring a page refresh.
Clicking Logout clears the session and returns the UI to the logged-out state; subsequent Login works again.
No uncaught promise errors or console loops occur during login/logout interactions.
No edits are made to immutable files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts and frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts.

file_operations.description: Add a small wrapper hook around useInternetIdentity that provides guarded, idempotent login/logout actions (e.g., in-flight mutex, timeouts, and waiting for identity to settle) to prevent repeated-click races and inconsistent states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Switch the existing Login/Logout button logic to use the new reliable auth wrapper (disable while an auth action is in-flight, handle the 'User is already authenticated' error by clearing then retrying once, and ensure react-query cache is cleared/cancelled on logout) while preserving all existing styling/classes and shadcn-ui Button usage. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure presale/airdrop submissions reliably open WhatsApp to the configured direct number when unlocked, and that pre-unlock submissions are saved and auto-redirect after unlock using the existing sessionStorage pending flow (no visual design changes).
acceptanceCriteria: When presale is unlocked, submitting the presale form opens WhatsApp using REDIRECT_CONFIG.whatsapp.directUrl (https://wa.me/923294238997) with the pre-filled message payload.
When airdrop is unlocked, submitting the airdrop form opens WhatsApp using REDIRECT_CONFIG.whatsapp.directUrl (https://wa.me/923294238997) with the pre-filled message payload.
If a user submits either form before unlock, the submission is saved and the app automatically redirects to WhatsApp after unlock (using the existing sessionStorage pending flow).
User-facing text remains in English and existing visual design (colors/typography/layout) is unchanged.

file_operations.description: Adjust form submit behavior so users can submit before unlock to save a pending submission (without requiring enabled timers), and ensure unlocked submissions and auto-redirect both use buildWhatsAppURL/REDIRECT_CONFIG.whatsapp.directUrl for https://wa.me/923294238997 with the same pre-filled message payload. Keep all existing layout/styling and shadcn-ui components intact. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden WhatsApp URL construction to always derive from REDIRECT_CONFIG.whatsapp.directUrl and reliably encode/format the pre-filled message payload used by Acquisition Portal submissions, without changing user-facing text. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Stabilize post-login initialization and query behavior so auth-gated pages consistently use the correct actor/identity/AccessControl state after login and reliably clear authenticated cached data on logout (no visual design changes).
acceptanceCriteria: After a successful Internet Identity login, pages that require authentication (e.g., Market Intel, Live Price, Market Pulse, Voting) can load their data without spurious Unauthorized errors caused by an actor/identity mismatch.
Logging out clears cached authenticated queries and prevents authenticated endpoints from being called with a stale identity.
No visual design changes are introduced.

file_operations.description: Create a non-visual initializer component that, once an authenticated actor is available, triggers a one-time backend initialization call (e.g., actor.initialize()) and coordinates react-query invalidation/refetch timing to avoid intermittent unauthorized states after login. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new AuthInitializer into the RootLayout so it runs globally (returns null, no UI impact) and ensures actor/permission initialization completes consistently after login. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Tighten react-query enabled/retry behavior for authenticated queries so they do not fire with a stale/transitioning actor identity and so authorization failures do not create retry loops; keep existing query keys and UI behavior unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
